environment.description: AWS Lambda function invoked through API Gateway (HTTP API) with VPC Link integration. The Lambda runs inside vpc-0a8b3c (10.200.0.0/16) in private subnets (no IGW route). Access is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4e8a2b interface endpoint provisioned in the consumer VPC, with endpoint policy restricting Principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalServiceRole. The API Gateway has no public DNS resolution — the execute-api endpoint has a resource policy denying all traffic not originating from vpce-0abc1234def. Security group sg-0x9f2a on the VPC endpoint allows inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.200.16.0/20 (internal service subnet). No NAT gateway or internet path exists in the Lambda's subnet route table. DNS resolution for the API endpoint only resolves within the VPC via private hosted zone association.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API with VPC Link, resource policy restricts to vpce-0abc1234def
config.network: Lambda in private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, VPC endpoint only
config.dns: Private hosted zone, no public DNS resolution for API endpoint
